set.relation: Conjunction of the four criteria below; contrasted in Section 9.6 with Kammerer & Frankish, Comşa & Shanahan, Binder et al. and Song et al. (song2025privileged), whose privileged-access definition the paper finds more compelling than the Comşa & Shanahan one.

Thicker alternative to the Comşa & Shanahan lightweight definition; lindsey2025emergent finds it more compelling than that one and ties it to its internality criterion; resembles resource-bounded definitions such as usable information under computational constraints.

adds.quote: Kammerer and Frankish [22] propose the following definition of introspection (applied to the case of LLMs by Long [27]): “Introspection is a process by which a cognitive system represents its own current mental states, in a manner that allows the information to be used for online behavioural control.” This definition aligns with our requirement of metacognitive representations, but leaves aside the questions of grounding and internality.
adds.assumptions: A cognitive system with current mental states and an internal representation of them that is available for online behavioural control; borrowed from Kammerer & Frankish (2023), applied to LLMs by Long.
adds.gloss: Introspection is a process by which a system represents its own current mental states so that the information can guide its ongoing behaviour.
adds.relation: Borrowed; the paper says it matches its metacognitive-representation criterion but omits grounding and internality; alternative to the Comşa & Shanahan causal-link definition and to the privileged-access definition of song2025privileged.

record_fixes.old: **TL;DR** Argues introspection requires privileged self-access: access more reliable than any equally cheap third-party process; LLMs' temperature self-reports track prompt framing and show no self-advantage over other models.
record_fixes.new: **TL;DR** Argues introspection requires privileged self-access, more reliable than any third-party process of no greater computational cost; LLMs' temperature self-reports track prompt framing, with no self-advantage over other models.
